title: `Eid ul-Fitr Suhbah
body:
As-salaamu `alaykum! Laa ilaaha illa-Llah Muhammadan Rasoolullah fa quti`a daabirul-qawmi ’Lladheena
zhalamoo.
`Eid Mubarak! We are asking Allah Almighty to give His heavenly support for Muslims, for the honor of
Sayyidina Muhammad (s). (Mawlana Shaykh stands and sits) We are very weak.
Allah Almighty is calling, “O My servants! I created you and granted you to be My servants, an honor no one
else can reach! O Mankind! (Mawlana Shaykh stands) I am sending you My most beloved servant, Sayyidina
Muhammad (s) to be your prophet, to call you to My Divine Presence. I am promising all Mankind that
whoever accepts to be from My most beloved servant’s nation must run! That is an honor I never granted to
any other of My servants. The highest servanthood I am granting to My most honored, most glorified servant
who was granted majesty from My Divinely Presence to My most beloved deputy as Crown Prince to all
nations, from pre-Eternal up to Eternal. Come and follow him and you will be granted power to look at My
Divinely Beauty!”
Allahu Akbar! Allahu Akbar! Allahu Akbar!

“O My servants! If you follow him, you will come to Me! If you are not following him you are following
Shaytan, who calls you to hells and punishment, to fall into huge fire mountains where you will be in the
hands of huge and terrible angels in Hellfire!” (Mawlana Shaykh sits)
Yaa Rabbee! We are mostly running after our egos as we are so ignorant! O our Lord! Send us from your most
beloved one in Your Divinely Presence what he promised You will send when people are losing their ways.
That is Your promise. O our Lord! We lost the ways that lead us to Paradise! We are so ignorant ones that we
have taken wrong ones as our leaders, and they are taking us to Hellfire, to endless difficulties, endless
miseries, endless troubles and we are following them!
O Mankind! You left the ways to Paradise and followed Shaytan’s people that lead you to endless trouble
oceans, and you will never be pleased here or be happy there! Those Shaytan people fill east and west; one of
them can make people kill each other and the Lord of Heavens will never be happy with them! They are
running after democracy and leaving Shari`atallah, Allah's holy orders, and therefore, daily they will fall
more deeply into the darkness that covers east to west! Allah Almighty sends for us noor, heavenly lights to
follow.
O Mankind! Now there are such heavy punishments that will take half the people living on Earth, and it
makes them kill each other to give their punishment here!
O People! Repent! Come and listen to the Seal of Prophets (s), who is calling his nation and all people, aslim
taslam, “Come to Islam!” Like the Holy Prophet’s letter to Qisra: “I am calling you to surrender to the Lord of
Heavens, Who created you! Surrender to His orders and you will be in safety here and Hereafter; if not, you
will be punished and no one can save you.”
O People! (If you follow wrong ways and beliefs) no idea, principle, or governing body may save you from
divine punishment! Only those who are following the holy commands of Heavens will be saved and will reach
the Divinely Presence, to enjoy pleasure and happiness forever!
O People! Come; if not, you will only bring punishment on yourself.
May Allah forgive us. This is Holy Eid al-Fitr. We try to be obedient, but we have committed so many wrong

acts and wrong dealings with people, and we are so lazy to keep heavenly orders. Today we are asking for
forgiveness. At this moment, the Lord of Heavens is looking over His Divinely Throne, seeing people running
to Eid prayers, and He is saying, “O Angels! Look! My servants are running to come and say, “Allahu Akbar,
Allahu Akbar, Allahu Akbar wa lillahi ‘l-hamd! “My servants are making takbeer for Me! I forgive them for
the honor of My most glorified, My most majestic, My most beloved deputy. He is My servant, whom I have
dressed to be My deputy from pre-Eternal up to Eternal.”
O Nations! Come and believe reality and don’t follow shaytanic ways; it is not good and your honor will be
taken away and you will be punished. Tawbah yaa Rabbee, tawbah astaghfirullah. Allahu Akbar, Allahu
Akbar, Allahu Akbar wa lillahi ‘l-hamd!
Fatihah.
